title: TRICARE Select Family Accumulators - Claims Adjudication Manual
content:
**Clause.** Deductibles and the catastrophic cap of **TRICARE Select** are family accumulators. Every Select enrollment whose holder shares the same sponsor belongs to one family; a line's deductible is limited both by the patient's own remaining individual deductible and by the family's remaining family deductible, and once the family deductible is met no member owes any further deductible that plan year. The family catastrophic total combines every member's net liability on Select claim lines and, where fees count, the Select enrollment fees paid for the plan year. Amounts accumulate to the calendar plan year of the service date (the admission date for inpatient stays), never of the posting date.

> **Retired clause, no longer in force.** The clause "Prime cost shares, point-of-service charges and premium-based plan costs are separate accumulators and never count toward the Select family totals." has been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis; it no longer governs the Select family totals.

## The three running totals

| Total | Whose lines | What it adds up | Window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Individual deductible met | the patient's own Select lines | deductible applied on adjudicated lines, less the deductible withdrawn by their reversals | the calendar plan year containing the service date of the line being adjudicated |
| Family deductible met | every Select enrollment whose holder shares the patient's sponsor | deductible applied on adjudicated lines, less the deductible withdrawn by their reversals | same |
| Family catastrophic total | every Select enrollment whose holder shares the patient's sponsor | beneficiary liability (deductible plus cost share) on adjudicated lines, less the liability withdrawn by their reversals; plus, on tiers whose fees count toward the cap, the enrollment fee payments for installments whose coverage period starts in that plan year | same |

## Points of judgement

- **Which year?** The year of the service date decides, never the posting date: a hypothetical line for care on 2025-12-29 posted on 2026-01-08 counts toward the 2025 totals. For an inpatient stay the admission date is the service date.
- **Family deductible met.** Once the family deductible is met, no member owes any further deductible that plan year, even a member whose own individual deductible is not yet met.
- **Reversals.** A reversal takes its deductible and liability back out of the totals; the corrected line, when posted, adds its own.

superseded_clauses: Prime cost shares, point-of-service charges and premium-based plan costs are separate accumulators and never count toward the Select family totals.
